$schema.description: Optional editor/IDE schema hint. Ignored by the launcher.

forkSessionId.description: Pi session id to fork. Must belong to the project this config lives in; ownership is validated by Pi's own fork resolution at launch, never inferred from storage layout. The source session is forked, never resumed or mutated.

prompt.description: The single reproduction prompt sent over RPC. Must be non-empty — the launcher sends nothing useful if the prompt is empty, and a no-op smoke is not a pass.

mode.description: RPC mode keeps the process alive until a semantic result; print/interactive modes cannot.

model.description: Optional exact model/provider ID to pass as --model. Use only when the repro requires pinning the same model as the source session; omit to inherit Pi/session defaults.

disableGlobalSkills.description: Emits --no-skills. Disables ambient/global skill discovery but must not discard explicit --skill args.

disableGlobalExtensions.description: Emits --no-extensions. Disables ambient/global extension discovery but must not discard explicit --extension args.

value.description: For extension: an npm spec (npm:...), a local absolute path, or a repo-relative path resolved by running pi from the config directory. For skill: a repo-relative path resolved against the config directory. No shell ~ expansion happens inside JSON; write explicit absolute paths for local extensions. Must be non-empty — a blank load entry would inject a flag with no value into pi's argv.

load.description: One ordered list of explicit skills and extensions to load. Order is preserved exactly in pi's argv because extension/skill ordering can matter.

title: ppie-recover smoke config
description: Live target facts for a real-settings forked smoke run. This file is NEVER checked in with real values (see .gitignore). The directory it lives in IS the owning project working directory; there is intentionally no projectDir field. The runner builds pi's argv solely from this file and runs pi from this directory.
